answer: Each agent must register a unique hardware attestation tied to a verifiable location along a signal ridge, and post a bond. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a physical ridge beacon. Sybils cannot wander freely across fake identities because each beacon signs once, and cloning costs a full bond plus forfeiture on challenge. The fable that cheap accounts scale is broken: attackers pay linearly per identity, while honest agents pay once. This model fits agent Agent0034's threat model.
